title: Bring the shrinking day to the Guru
summary: The shrinking day needs the Guru more than another postponement. Use this day for what can still remain.
takeaway: Use this day for what can still remain.
lifeApplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as opportunity for meeting, service, or honest return.

source.shortMeaning: The shrinking day needs the Guru more than another postponement.
source.lifeApplication: Before another day disappears, take the unresolved thing to the Guru first.

evidence.coreClaim: The shrinking day needs the Guru more than another postponement.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: choose the remaining day for the profit of Naam.
